subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the single canonical tracker for both the Google thinking-payload sanitizer path and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios dependency path, or should the auth-stack path be split before any sanitizer-only PR lands?
rationale: The remaining work crosses provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and live-proof requirements, so automation should not decide whether a partial sanitizer fix is enough to close the broader user-facing crash report.

options.title: Keep one canonical tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until both the sanitizer path and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path have live proof or an explicit maintainer override.

options.title: Split auth-stack follow-up
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused canonical follow-up, then close this issue only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Accept sanitizer scope only
options.body: A provider owner can decide that the sanitizer PR is sufficient for this issue while preserving the ADC evidence in a separate durable place.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until both the sanitizer path and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path have live proof or an explicit maintainer override.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to the shared Google thinking helper history and is the best available owner for the cross-cutting close-or-split decision.
